arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Panner stated Article III requires a private plaintiff to show injury-in-fact.
He argued factual injury does not automatically follow from a statutory violation.
Mr. Panner claimed a violation of a duty is not itself an injury.
Justice Sotomayor questioned if the argument applies to statutory damages broadly.
